item.title: Under drone fire, exiled Kurds wait to confront Iranian regime
item.summary: A group of fighters based in Iraq say they are "ready to go home", as they face drone attacks from Tehran.

item.title: Family of Michigan synagogue suspect killed in Lebanon airstrike, officials say
item.summary: The FBI said the suspect had large quantities of fireworks and petrol in his vehicle when it caught fire after ramming a synagogue on Thursday.

item.title: Bodies of 84 Iranian sailors killed in US torpedo strike to be repatriated
item.summary: The seamen died when Iranian warship the Iris Dena was sunk on 4 March by a US submarine near Sri Lanka.

item.title: More US Marines and warships to be moved to Middle East, reports say
item.summary: The reinforcements will come from an amphibious ready group that is usually based in Japan, an official told CBS, the BBC's US partner.

item.title: Bahrain & Saudi Arabia Grands Prix to be cancelled
item.summary: The Bahrain and Saudi Arabia Grands Prix scheduled for next month are set to be cancelled as a result of the Middle East war.

item.title: Ukraine and allies fear easing Russian sanctions will prolong war
item.summary: Ukraine's president says the US decision "certainly does not help achieve peace".

item.title: Rescuers blame weather and 'underprepared skiers' for rise in Alps avalanche deaths
item.summary: The BBC joins a French Alps rescue team as the number of skiers killed this season passes 100.

item.title: Pink Floyd guitar sold for record-breaking $14.6m
item.summary: The guitar was used by David Gilmour on some of Pink Floyd's best-known albums, including Dark Side of the Moon.

item.title: Explosion at Amsterdam Jewish school 'a deliberate attack' says mayor
item.summary: Security had been increased at Jewish public institutions following an earlier incident in Rotterdam.

item.title: King expressed 'concern' over Alberta separatists, say First Nations chiefs
item.summary: Indigenous leaders made Charles aware of the "threat" posed by the movement during a meeting in London, they say.
